api.probe(cfg, u): u2/u4: one isolated run on the first three registered states of replicate 0 per early_probes arm, default A/B/R. Current A is its trained checkpoint, independent of the common-u0 reference. Other updates return not_scheduled with zero work.

api.read_monitor(root): Read and validate all-arm v1/v2 histories and diagnostic summaries without writing or requiring external component cfg.

configuration.run_root: Required existing experiment root owned by the coordinator.
configuration.group_credit: Mapping with explicit boolean enabled; default false. True retains strict numeric WM measurements and positive credit_rows for B/R.
configuration.dense_teacher: Mapping with explicit boolean enabled; default false. True retains strict label counts, CE/accuracy, calibrated filtered share and sampled-accuracy checks for B/R.
configuration.track2_reward: P2 boolean switch, default false. For redesigned launch use true, group_credit.enabled=false and dense_teacher.enabled=false.
configuration.track2_reward_weight: Required positive finite registered weight when reward is enabled; no monitor-chosen default.
configuration.track2_reward_provenance: Required nonempty weight-registration authority reference when reward is enabled; preserved and checked against P2 receipts.
configuration.track2_reward_arms: P2 contract: exactly B and R, defaults to B/R. A cannot report a cooperation reward receipt.
configuration.learning_monitor: Defaults: history_updates=3, trigger_saturation=[0,1], accuracy_tolerance=1e-6, layer_kl_near_zero=1e-8. Learning diagnoses never pause; explicit safety_stop alone requests PAUSE_SAFETY.
configuration.isolated_registration: Explicit in-memory TRAIN registration: metric=policy_cooperation_gain_veh_s, five replicates indexed 0..4, distinct existing TRAIN seeds 986000..986071 and SHA256 state/window identities.
configuration.monitor_dry_run: Default true: expand/quote full windows, reserve/dispatch zero jobs. Live execution only through coordinator-supplied hooks.
configuration.monitor_backend.resolve_states(job): Return [(snapshot, bank_receipt)] for registered world/state/window set.
configuration.monitor_backend.weights(arm, update): Return (actual current complete policy state dict, common frozen u0 state dict). Common must match across all cells; current must stay fixed per arm/update. A-current is allowed and expected to change from u0 after PPO training.
configuration.monitor_backend.reserve(jobs, phase): Atomically precharge WHOLE wave against coordinator's own ledger, returning {reserved:true, phase, sim_s, job_ids}; sim_s and ordered IDs must match expanded specs.
configuration.monitor_backend.run_branch(spec, snapsho: Owning coordinator supplies worker permit and qualified full-layer policy controller. Return {status:graded, J_veh_s:finite, safety:all four nonnegative integer counters}. No runner/process/checkpoint reader is constructed by P3.
configuration.budget.phases: Required early_probes/isolated_replicated phase caps; optional early_probes.sim_s_per_arm and isolated_test.sim_s_per_replicate cell caps. Whole expanded windows must fit; cumulative <=5M ledger remains coordinator-owned.
configuration.isolated_test: Exactly five replicates; bootstrap 10000 percentile WORLD resamples, level .95, seed 20261104.
configuration.criterion_sha256: Optional binding to coordinator's registered criterion; live owner approval/preflight remains coordinator-owned.

canonical_metrics.disabled_wm: group_credit_wm/group_credit_checked must be None; credit_rows/credit_checked_rows must be zero.
canonical_metrics.disabled_dense: dense_ce/dense_accuracy/dense_filtered_share/dense_checked_accuracy must be None; dense_labels/dense_eligible_labels/dense_checked_labels must be zero.
canonical_metrics.enabled_subsets: Zero checked rows require None subset measurements. All-filtered dense targets permit None CE/accuracy and diagnose no eligible labels only when dense teaching is enabled.

track2_reward.shape: Native P2 training_episodes or layer_records receipt nested at metrics.track2_reward. Required for B/R when cfg.track2_reward=true; absent/None when disabled or A. Additional native provenance fields are preserved.
track2_reward.semantics: P2 sums of per-step equal-acting-CAV means, not global SUMO reward or WM counterfactual credit. Counts/sums are exposed verbatim; sums must be finite and consistent with registered weight. Scope is cooperation layer only; WM/global reward use and terminal fallback refuse. Existing metrics.reward retains base/evaluation meaning.
